final: WITH g AS (SELECT r.circuitId AS circuitId, c.country AS country, AVG(r."round") AS ra FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY r.circuitId, c.country), ca AS (SELECT country, AVG(ra) AS cavg FROM g GROUP BY country) SELECT g.circuitId, g.country, g.ra, g.ra - ca.cavg AS diff FROM g JOIN ca ON ca.country = g.country ORDER BY diff DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
